vocabulary.definition: a very steep rock face or cliff, typically a tall one
vocabulary.example: The hikers were careful not to get too close to the edge of the precipice.

vocabulary.definition: charmed or enchanted someone, sometimes in a deceptive way
vocabulary.example: The con artist beguiled the elderly woman into giving him all her savings.

vocabulary.definition: to secretly enter or join a group in order to gain influence or information
vocabulary.example: The spy successfully infiltrated the enemy's organization.

vocabulary.definition: impossible to satisfy or quench; always wanting more
vocabulary.example: Her insatiable curiosity led her to explore every corner of the ancient ruins.

vocabulary.definition: to escape or avoid, usually by cleverness or trickery
vocabulary.example: The thief evaded the police by blending into the crowded streets.

vocabulary.definition: not clearly visible or attracting attention; not conspicuous
vocabulary.example: She tried to remain inconspicuous in the back of the classroom.
